== Title ==
<span lang="ja">反乱軍スノースピーダー</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">パイロットと乗客のどちらかを追加で1名乗せられる。能力値1の専属パイロットが搭乗している。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ホスの反乱軍基地の技師たちは、エアスピーダーＴ－４７を改造し、氷の惑星の極寒の大気の中でも飛行できるようにした。密閉型。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Rebel Snowspeeder.

'''Lore''' — Engineers at the Rebel base on Hoth modified the T-47 airspeeder to fly in the frigid atmosphere of the ice planet. Enclosed.

'''Game text''' — May carry one additional pilot or passenger. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard.

Both faces allow one additional pilot or passenger and show a permanent pilot of ability 1.<ref>[[:File:ESB2P-L-rebelsnowspeeder.gif|Original English face]], [[Rebel Snowspeeder]].</ref>
